title: The Book of 2 Timothy Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of 2 Timothy — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
verses.decoded: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ, chosen by God's will, based on the promise of eternal life found in Christ Jesus,

verses.kjv: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.decoded: To Timothy, my dear son: I wish you grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;
verses.decoded: I thank God, whom I serve with a clear conscience as my ancestors did, and I constantly remember you in my prayers day and night;

verses.kjv: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
verses.decoded: I earnestly want to see you again, remembering how you cried, so that I may be filled with joy.

verses.kjv: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
verses.decoded: When I remember your sincere faith, which first lived in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice, I am convinced it is also in you.

verses.kjv: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
verses.decoded: So I remind you to actively use the gift God gave you when I laid my hands on you.

verses.kjv: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
verses.decoded: For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but one of power, love, and self-discipline.

verses.kjv: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;
verses.decoded: So don’t be ashamed to tell others about our Lord, or of me, his prisoner. Instead, share in the suffering for the gospel by God’s power.

verses.kjv: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,
verses.decoded: God saved us and called us to a holy purpose—not because of anything we did, but because of his own plan and grace given to us in Christ Jesus before time began.

verses.kjv: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
verses.decoded: But now this grace has been revealed through the coming of our Savior Jesus Christ, who destroyed death and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel.

verses.kjv: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
verses.decoded: I was appointed to be a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher for the Gentiles.

verses.kjv: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
verses.decoded: Because of this, I endure suffering, but I am not ashamed. I know whom I have trusted, and I am sure he can protect what I have entrusted to him until that day.

verses.kjv: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.decoded: Hold firmly to the trustworthy teachings you received from me, along with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.
verses.decoded: Guard the good message entrusted to you by the Holy Spirit who lives in us.

verses.kjv: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
verses.decoded: You know that everyone in the province of Asia has deserted me, including Phygellus and Hermogenes.

verses.kjv: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
verses.decoded: May the Lord show kindness to the family of Onesiphorus, because he often encouraged me and was not embarrassed by my imprisonment.

verses.kjv: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.
verses.decoded: When Onesiphorus was in Rome, he searched hard for me and finally found me.

verses.kjv: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
verses.decoded: May the Lord grant him mercy on that day, and you know well how many ways he helped me while I was in Ephesus.

verses.kjv: Thou therefore, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.decoded: So, my son, be strong by relying on the grace that comes through Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: And the things that thou hast heard of me among many witnesses, the same commit thou to faithful men, who shall be able to teach others also.
verses.decoded: Pass on to trustworthy people what you learned from me, so they can teach others as well.

verses.kjv: Thou therefore endure hardness, as a good soldier of Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: Endure hardships like a dedicated soldier serving Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: No man that warreth entangleth himself with the affairs of this life; that he may please him who hath chosen him to be a soldier.
verses.decoded: A soldier doesn’t get distracted by everyday life so he can focus on pleasing the one who enlisted him.

verses.kjv: And if a man also strive for masteries, yet is he not crowned, except he strive lawfully.
verses.decoded: Athletes only receive a prize if they compete according to the rules.

verses.kjv: The husbandman that laboureth must be first partaker of the fruits.
verses.decoded: A farmer who works hard should be the first to enjoy the harvest.

verses.kjv: Consider what I say; and the Lord give thee understanding in all things.
verses.decoded: Think carefully about what I’m saying, and may the Lord help you understand everything.

verses.kjv: Remember that Jesus Christ of the seed of David was raised from the dead according to my gospel:
verses.decoded: Remember that Jesus Christ, a descendant of David, was raised from the dead as I preached.

verses.kjv: Wherein I suffer trouble, as an evil doer, even unto bonds; but the word of God is not bound.
verses.decoded: I suffer like a criminal, even imprisoned, but God’s message cannot be chained.

verses.kjv: Therefore I endure all things for the elect’s sakes, that they may also obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
verses.decoded: So I endure everything for the sake of God’s chosen people, so they may receive salvation and eternal glory through Christ.

verses.kjv: It is a faithful saying: For if we be dead with him, we shall also live with him:
verses.decoded: This is a trustworthy statement: If we die with Christ, we will also live with him.

verses.kjv: If we suffer, we shall also reign with him: if we deny him, he also will deny us:
verses.decoded: If we suffer for Christ, we will also reign with him; but if we reject him, he will reject us.

verses.kjv: If we believe not, yet he abideth faithful: he cannot deny himself.
verses.decoded: Even if we are unfaithful, Christ remains faithful because he cannot deny who he is.

verses.kjv: Of these things put them in remembrance, charging them before the Lord that they strive not about words to no profit, but to the subverting of the hearers.
verses.decoded: Remind them of these truths and warn them before the Lord not to argue over useless words that only confuse listeners.

verses.kjv: Study to shew thyself approved unto God, a workman that needeth not to be ashamed, rightly dividing the word of truth.
verses.decoded: Work hard to show yourself approved by God, a worker who correctly handles the message of truth and has no reason to be ashamed.

verses.kjv: But shun profane and vain babblings: for they will increase unto more ungodliness.
verses.decoded: Avoid godless and empty talk, because it will lead to even more ungodly behavior.

verses.kjv: And their word will eat as doth a canker: of whom is Hymenæus and Philetus;
verses.decoded: Their teaching spreads like a disease, and Hymenaeus and Philetus are examples of this.

verses.kjv: Who concerning the truth have erred, saying that the resurrection is past already; and overthrow the faith of some.
verses.decoded: They have made a mistake about the truth by claiming that the resurrection has already happened, and this has caused some people to lose their faith.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his. And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.
verses.decoded: But God’s foundation remains firm, marked by this truth: The Lord knows those who belong to Him. So, everyone who calls on the name of Christ should turn away from sin.

verses.kjv: But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.
verses.decoded: In a large household, there are not only valuable items made of gold and silver but also common ones made of wood and clay; some are for honorable use, others for dishonorable use.

verses.kjv: If a man therefore purge himself from these, he shall be a vessel unto honour, sanctified, and meet for the master’s use, and prepared unto every good work.
verses.decoded: So if someone cleanses themselves from these things, they will become a vessel for honorable use, set apart and ready for the master’s service, prepared for every good work.

verses.kjv: Flee also youthful lusts: but follow righteousness, faith, charity, peace, with them that call on the Lord out of a pure heart.
verses.decoded: Run away from youthful desires, but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace, along with those who sincerely call on the Lord.

verses.kjv: But foolish and unlearned questions avoid, knowing that they do gender strifes.
verses.decoded: Avoid foolish and ignorant arguments because they cause quarrels.

verses.kjv: And the servant of the Lord must not strive; but be gentle unto all men, apt to teach, patient,
verses.decoded: The Lord’s servant should not argue but be kind to everyone, able to teach, and patient.

verses.kjv: In meekness instructing those that oppose themselves; if God peradventure will give them repentance to the acknowledging of the truth;
verses.decoded: Gently correct those who oppose the truth, hoping that God will give them repentance leading to a true knowledge of the gospel.

verses.kjv: And that they may recover themselves out of the snare of the devil, who are taken captive by him at his will.
verses.decoded: So they can escape from the devil’s trap, where he has captured them and holds them captive by his will.

verses.kjv: This know also, that in the last days perilous times shall come.
verses.decoded: Understand this too: in the final days, dangerous and difficult times will arrive.

verses.kjv: For men shall be lovers of their own selves, covetous, boasters, proud, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,
verses.decoded: People will be selfish, greedy, boastful, arrogant, disrespectful to parents, ungrateful, and ungodly.

verses.kjv: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,
verses.decoded: They will lack natural love, break promises, spread lies, be uncontrolled, violent, and hate those who do good.

verses.kjv: Traitors, heady, highminded, lovers of pleasures more than lovers of God;
verses.decoded: They will be traitors, reckless, arrogant, and more interested in pleasure than in loving God.

verses.kjv: Having a form of godliness, but denying the power thereof: from such turn away.
verses.decoded: They will pretend to be godly but will reject its true power; stay away from people like that.

verses.kjv: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,
verses.decoded: These people sneak into homes and manipulate vulnerable women who are burdened by sins and various desires.

verses.kjv: Ever learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.decoded: They keep studying but never truly understand the truth.

verses.kjv: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, reprobate concerning the faith.
verses.decoded: Just like Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, these people resist the truth; they have corrupt minds and lack true faith.

verses.kjv: But they shall proceed no further: for their folly shall be manifest unto all men, as theirs also was.
verses.decoded: But they won’t succeed; their foolishness will become obvious to everyone, just like those magicians.

verses.kjv: But thou hast fully known my doctrine, manner of life, purpose, faith, longsuffering, charity, patience,
verses.decoded: But you have thoroughly learned my teaching, way of life, goals, faith, patience, love, and endurance.

verses.kjv: Persecutions, afflictions, which came unto me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; what persecutions I endured: but out of them all the Lord delivered me.
verses.decoded: I faced persecutions and hardships in Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra, but the Lord rescued me from all of them.

verses.kjv: Yea, and all that will live godly in Christ Jesus shall suffer persecution.
verses.decoded: Indeed, everyone who wants to live a godly life in Christ Jesus will face persecution.

verses.kjv: But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived.
verses.decoded: But evil people and deceivers will become more and more corrupt, misleading others and being misled themselves.

verses.kjv: But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them;
verses.decoded: But keep holding on to what you have learned and are confident about, remembering who taught you.

verses.kjv: And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.
verses.decoded: Since you were a child, you have known the holy Scriptures, which can make you wise and lead you to salvation through faith in Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness:
verses.decoded: Every part of Scripture is inspired by God and is useful for teaching, for showing people when they are wrong, for correcting faults, and for guiding them in living rightly.

verses.kjv: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works.
verses.decoded: So that God’s servant may be fully equipped and prepared to do every good work.

verses.kjv: I CHARGE thee therefore before God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, who shall judge the quick and the dead at his appearing and his kingdom;
verses.decoded: Therefore, I solemnly urge you in the presence of God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead when he appears and establishes his kingdom;

verses.kjv: Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season; reprove, rebuke, exhort with all longsuffering and doctrine.
verses.decoded: Preach the message consistently, whether it is convenient or not; correct, warn, and encourage others patiently and carefully teaching sound doctrine.

verses.kjv: For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine; but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears;
verses.decoded: Because a time will come when people will no longer accept true teaching; instead, they will gather teachers who tell them what they want to hear, satisfying their own desires.

verses.kjv: And they shall turn away their ears from the truth, and shall be turned unto fables.
verses.decoded: They will turn away from listening to the truth and will be attracted to myths and false stories.

verses.kjv: But watch thou in all things, endure afflictions, do the work of an evangelist, make full proof of thy ministry.
verses.decoded: But you, be alert in everything, endure hardships, do the work of a messenger of the gospel, and fully complete your ministry.

verses.kjv: For I am now ready to be offered, and the time of my departure is at hand.
verses.decoded: For I am already being poured out like a drink offering, and the time for me to leave this life is near.

verses.kjv: I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith:
verses.decoded: I have fought the good fight, I have completed the race, and I have remained faithful.

verses.kjv: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing.
verses.decoded: Now there is reserved for me a crown of righteousness that the Lord, the righteous judge, will give me on that day—and not only to me but also to all who eagerly await his return.

verses.kjv: Do thy diligence to come shortly unto me:
verses.decoded: Make every effort to come to me soon.

verses.kjv: For Demas hath forsaken me, having loved this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
verses.decoded: Because Demas has abandoned me, loving this world, and has gone to Thessalonica; Crescens has gone to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.

verses.kjv: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
verses.decoded: Only Luke is with me now. Take Mark and bring him with you because he is helpful in the ministry.

verses.kjv: And Tychicus have I sent to Ephesus.
verses.decoded: I have sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

verses.kjv: The cloke that I left at Troas with Carpus, when thou comest, bring with thee, and the books, but especially the parchments.
verses.decoded: When you come, bring the cloak I left with Carpus at Troas, along with the books, especially the scrolls.

verses.kjv: Alexander the coppersmith did me much evil: the Lord reward him according to his works:
verses.decoded: Alexander the coppersmith caused me great harm; may the Lord repay him according to what he has done.

verses.kjv: Of whom be thou ware also; for he hath greatly withstood our words.
verses.decoded: Be on your guard against him too, because he strongly opposed our message.

verses.kjv: At my first answer no man stood with me, but all men forsook me: I pray God that it may not be laid to their charge.
verses.decoded: When I first gave my defense, no one stood by me; everyone abandoned me. I pray to God that they will not be held accountable for this.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding the Lord stood with me, and strengthened me; that by me the preaching might be fully known, and that all the Gentiles might hear: and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.
verses.decoded: But the Lord stood by me and gave me strength so that through me the message could be fully proclaimed and all the Gentiles could hear it. I was rescued from a deadly threat.

verses.kjv: And the Lord shall deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me unto his heavenly kingdom: to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.decoded: The Lord will rescue me from every evil attack and will keep me safe until I reach His heavenly kingdom. To Him be glory forever and ever. Amen.

verses.kjv: Salute Prisca and Aquila, and the household of Onesiphorus.
verses.decoded: Send my greetings to Prisca and Aquila, and to the family of Onesiphorus.

verses.kjv: Erastus abode at Corinth: but Trophimus have I left at Miletum sick.
verses.decoded: Erastus is staying in Corinth, but I left Trophimus sick in Miletus.

verses.kjv: Do thy diligence to come before winter. Eubulus greeteth thee, and Pudens, and Linus, and Claudia, and all the brethren.
verses.decoded: Make every effort to come before winter. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers send their greetings to you.

verses.kjv: The Lord Jesus Christ be with thy spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.
verses.decoded: May the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. May grace be with you. Amen. (This second letter to Timothy, the first bishop of the church in Ephesus, was written from Rome when Paul was brought before Nero for the second time.)
